dependencies.name: espeak-ng
dependencies.integration: separate native process using stdin and stdout
dependencies.installation: distribution-managed espeak-ng executable and matching voice/data files
dependencies.runtime_identity: GET /capabilities phonemizer.engine reports the actual installed version and en-us voice
dependencies.deployment_receipt: Record the distribution package version, binary/data digests, package source recipe, patches and dependency notices for the installed build.
dependencies.redistribution: No native binary is included in this application. A release that adds one must include its matching corresponding source and notices; the upstream source link alone does not identify a patched distribution build.
dependencies.missing_behavior: Return phonemizer_unavailable; corpus access and ordinary speech transcription remain independent.
